image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large crocodile resting on a sandy, debris-strewn riverbank. The reptile's head and upper torso are clearly visible, showcasing its textured, armored skin and closed jaws. The lighting is bright with strong shadows, highlighting the rough texture of the scales and the surrounding dry vegetation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nostrils in a V-shape, consistent with crocodilian morphology rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The jawline shows a serrated edge where teeth interlock; specifically, the fourth lower tooth appears to fit into the upper jaw notch, a key diagnostic feature.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is located on the top ridge of the skull. While the pupil shape is hard to resolve at this resolution, the positioning is correct for a semi-aquatic ambush predator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two distinct nostril openings are visible at the very end of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body extends out of frame, implying significant length, and is covered in heavy dermal armor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony scutes run parallel down the spine and back, matching the anatomical description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of earthy browns and greys, and the texture appears extremely rough and calcified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The crocodile is lying on its belly; the ventral side is completely occluded by the ground and the animal's own body mass.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are tucked under the body or obscured by foreground vegetation and shadows, making digit counting and webbing verification impossible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the right side of the image frame; only the base is visible, preventing assessment of its full length or compression.

alignment_reasoning: All testable checkpoints regarding head morphology, snout shape, tooth visibility, and dorsal scute arrangement are fully present and accurate. Non-testable checkpoints (ventral scales, limbs, full tail) are logically occluded or out of frame. The image exhibits perfect class conformance for Crocodylus niloticus.
artifact_reasoning: No AI-generation artifacts detected. Skin texture is highly detailed and consistent with biological reality. Lighting and shadows are physically coherent. Edges between the subject and the complex background vegetation are sharp and natural, showing no signs of melting, fusion, or boundary bleeding.

metadata.class_label: African crocodile, Nile crocodile, Crocodylus niloticus
